/* ---------- Pengenal ucapan untuk menu Bicara & Penerjemah ---------- */
const LT = {on:false, onText:null, lang:'id-ID', web:null};
const LTS = {sess:null, last:''};
function sttStart(lang, onText){
  sttStop();
  LTS.sess = null; LTS.last = '';            // jangan bawa sisa ucapan sesi sebelumnya
  LT.on = true; LT.onText = onText; LT.lang = lang;
  if (window.Android && Android.startImam && Android.hasImamRecognizer && Android.hasImamRecognizer()){
    RG.on = true; RG.kind = 'native'; RG.sess = -1;
    try{ Android.startImam(lang); }catch(e){}
    return true;
  }
  const R = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
  if (!R){ LT.on = false; toast(T('Pengenalan ucapan tidak tersedia di perangkat ini.')); return false; }
  const go = () => {
    if (!LT.on) return;
    const r = new R(); r.lang = lang; r.continuous = true; r.interimResults = true;
    r.onresult = e => {
      let fin = '', mid = '';
      for (let k = e.resultIndex; k < e.results.length; k++){ if (e.results[k].isFinal) fin += e.results[k][0].transcript; else mid += e.results[k][0].transcript; }
      if (fin.trim()) LT.onText(fin.trim(), true); else if (mid.trim()) LT.onText(mid.trim(), false);
    };
    r.onerror = ev => { if (ev.error==='not-allowed'){ LT.on = false; window.onImamState('denied'); } else if (ev.error==='network') window.onImamState('network'); };
    r.onend = () => { if (LT.on) setTimeout(go, 150); };
    LT.web = r; try{ r.start(); }catch(e){}
  };
  go(); return true;
}
function sttStop(){
  if (!LT.on) return;
  LT.on = false;
  if (RG.kind==='native' && RG.on){ RG.on = false; try{ Android.stopImam(); }catch(e){} }
  if (LT.web){ try{ LT.web.stop(); }catch(e){} LT.web = null; }
}
/* hasil dari pengenal suara Android: per sesi, sebagian lalu final */
function nativeSttText(text, isFinal, sess){
  if (!LT.on || !LT.onText) return;
  if (LTS.sess !== null && sess !== LTS.sess && LTS.last){ LT.onText(LTS.last, true); }
  LTS.sess = sess; LTS.last = isFinal ? '' : text;
  LT.onText(text, isFinal);
}

/* ---------- Suara (text to speech) ---------- */
const TTS = {cb:{}, n:0, voices:null};
function webVoices(){ try{ return window.speechSynthesis ? speechSynthesis.getVoices() : []; }catch(e){ return []; } }
const FEM = /female|woman|frau|femme|zira|susan|hazel|samantha|karen|moira|tessa|veena|fiona|victoria|amira|damayanti|salma|laila|yelda|amelie|monica|paulina|mei|ting|kyoko|yuna|lekha|heera|kalpana|sabina|helena|anna/i;
const MAL = /\bmale\b|\bman\b|david|mark|george|daniel|alex|fred|rishi|maged|andika|tarik|thomas|jorge|diego|otoya|ichiro|hemant|stefan|yannick|ravi|kangkang|haruka/i;
/* daftar suara: {n:nama, q:kualitas, net:butuh internet} */
function voiceList(lang){
  if (window.Android && Android.ttsVoices){
    try{ return JSON.parse(Android.ttsVoices(SPLX[lang][1])).map(v => typeof v === 'string' ? {n:v, q:0, net:false} : v); }catch(e){ return []; }
  }
  return webVoices().filter(v => v.lang && v.lang.toLowerCase().startsWith(lang)).map(v => ({n:v.name, q:0, net:!v.localService}));
}
/* perkiraan jenis suara Google TTS (laki-laki / perempuan) */
const GV = {'id-id-x-idd':'l','id-id-x-ide':'l','id-id-x-idc':'p','id-id-x-dfz':'p',
  'en-us-x-iol':'l','en-us-x-iom':'l','en-us-x-tpd':'l','en-us-x-iob':'p','en-us-x-iog':'p','en-us-x-tpc':'p','en-us-x-tpf':'p','en-us-x-sfg':'p',
  'ar-xa-x-ard':'l','ar-xa-x-are':'l','ar-xa-x-arc':'p','ar-xa-x-arz':'p'};
const vGender = n => { const k = Object.keys(GV).find(x => n.toLowerCase().startsWith(x)); return k ? GV[k] : (MAL.test(n) && !FEM.test(n) ? 'l' : (FEM.test(n) ? 'p' : '')); };
/* suara terbaik untuk satu jenis: kualitas tertinggi, suara online (lebih alami) bila ada internet */
function autoVoice(lang, g){
  const want = g==='a' ? 'p' : g, list = voiceList(lang);
  if (!list.length) return '';
  const on = navigator.onLine !== false;
  const score = v => (v.q||0) + (vGender(v.n)===want ? 1000 : 0) + (v.net ? (on ? 50 : -500) : 0);
  const best = list.slice().sort((a, b) => score(b) - score(a))[0];
  return vGender(best.n)===want ? best.n : '';
}
function voiceFor(lang, g){ return S.vmap[lang+'_'+g] || autoVoice(lang, g); }
function pickWebVoice(lang, g){
  const want = S.vmap[lang+'_'+g];
  const vs = webVoices().filter(v => v.lang && v.lang.toLowerCase().startsWith(lang));
  if (want){ const v = vs.find(x => x.name===want); if (v) return v; }
  if (g==='l'){ const v = vs.find(x => MAL.test(x.name) && !FEM.test(x.name)); if (v) return v; }
  if (g==='p' || g==='a'){ const v = vs.find(x => FEM.test(x.name)); if (v) return v; }
  return vs[0] || null;
}
function speak(text, lang, vkey, done){
  text = String(text || '').trim(); if (!text){ if (done) done(''); return; }
  const v = VOICES[vkey] || VOICES.p1, tag = SPLX[lang] ? SPLX[lang][1] : lang;
  if (window.Android && Android.speak){
    const id = 's' + (++TTS.n); TTS.cb[id] = done;
    try{ Android.speak(id, text, tag, voiceFor(lang, v.g), v.pitch, v.rate); }catch(e){ if (done) done('err'); }
    return;
  }
  if (window.speechSynthesis && window.SpeechSynthesisUtterance){
    const u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = tag; u.pitch = v.pitch; u.rate = v.rate;
    const wv = pickWebVoice(lang, v.g); if (wv) u.voice = wv;
    u.onend = () => done && done(''); u.onerror = () => done && done('err');
    speechSynthesis.cancel(); speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return;
  }
  toast(T('Perangkat ini belum bisa mengeluarkan suara.')); if (done) done('err');
}
function stopSpeak(){ try{ if (window.Android && Android.stopSpeak) Android.stopSpeak(); else if (window.speechSynthesis) speechSynthesis.cancel(); }catch(e){} }
window.onSpeakDone = (id, err) => {
  const f = TTS.cb[id]; delete TTS.cb[id];
  if (err==='lang') toast(T('Suara untuk bahasa ini belum tersedia di HP. Pasang di Pengaturan HP > Text-to-speech.'));
  if (f) f(err);
};
/* bicara sambil menghentikan mikrofon sementara, agar HP tidak mendengar suaranya sendiri */
function speakPaused(text, lang, vkey, resume){
  const wasOn = LT.on, cb = LT.onText, ll = LT.lang;
  if (wasOn) sttStop();
  speak(text, lang, vkey, () => { if (wasOn && resume !== false) setTimeout(() => { if (!LT.on) sttStart(ll, cb); refreshMics(); }, 350); refreshMics(); });
  refreshMics();
}

/* ---------- Terjemahan ---------- */
const TRQ = {cb:{}, n:0};
function translateText(text, src, tgt){
  return new Promise((res, rej) => {
    text = String(text || '').trim();
    if (!text) return res('');
    if (src === tgt) return res(text);
    if (window.Android && Android.translate){
      const id = 't' + (++TRQ.n); TRQ.cb[id] = {res, rej};
      try{ Android.translate(id, text, src, tgt); }catch(e){ delete TRQ.cb[id]; rej('err'); }
      return;
    }
    fetch('https://api.mymemory.translated.net/get?q=' + encodeURIComponent(text) + '&langpair=' + src + '|' + tgt)
      .then(r => r.json()).then(j => { const t = j && j.responseData && j.responseData.translatedText; t ? res(t) : rej('err'); })
      .catch(() => rej('net'));
  });
}
window.onTranslated = (id, text, err) => { const c = TRQ.cb[id]; if (!c) return; delete TRQ.cb[id]; err ? c.rej(err) : c.res(text); };
window.onTranslateProgress = (id, what) => { if (what==='download') trStatus(T('Mengunduh paket bahasa (sekali saja, butuh internet)…')); };
function trErr(e){ return T(e==='lang' ? 'Bahasa ini belum didukung untuk terjemahan.' : 'Terjemahan gagal. Periksa internet lalu coba lagi.'); }

/* ---------- Panel pilihan suara ---------- */
function openVoicePanel(title, lang, cur, onPick, ctx){
  $('vpTitle').textContent = title;
  const draw = () => {
    const v = VOICES[cur];
    const groups = [['l', T('Laki-laki')], ['p', T('Perempuan')], ['a', T('Anak')]];
    let h = '';
    groups.forEach(([g, gl]) => {
      h += `<div class="set"><label class="t">${esc(gl)}</label><div class="chips">` +
        Object.keys(VOICES).filter(k => VOICES[k].g===g).map(k => `<button data-v="${k}" aria-pressed="${k===cur}">${esc(T(VOICES[k].n))}</button>`).join('') + '</div></div>';
    });
    const list = voiceList(lang), key = lang + '_' + v.g;
    h += `<div class="set vsec"><label class="t">${esc(T('Suara mesin ({l})', {l: SPLX[lang][2]}))}</label>
      <select id="vpEngine"><option value="">${esc(T('Otomatis (paling alami)'))}</option>${list.map((v, k) => {
        const gg = vGender(v.n), tag = (gg==='l' ? T('laki-laki') : gg==='p' ? T('perempuan') : '') + (v.net ? ' · ' + T('online, lebih alami') : '') + (v.q >= 400 ? ' · ' + T('kualitas tinggi') : '');
        return `<option value="${esc(v.n)}"${S.vmap[key]===v.n?' selected':''}>${esc(T('Suara {n}', {n:k+1}))}${tag ? ' (' + esc(tag) + ')' : ''}</option>`; }).join('')}</select>
      <small>${esc(T('Suara online (Google) jauh lebih alami. Agar suara terdengar seperti manusia: buka Pengaturan HP > Output text-to-speech > Google > Instal data suara, lalu unduh suara bahasa ini.'))}</small></div>`;
    if (ctx==='talk') h += `<div class="set vsec"><label class="t">${esc(T('Suara manusia asli untuk kalimat cepat'))}</label>
      <small>${esc(T('Rekam suara keluarga atau teman sekali saja. Kalimat cepat akan diputar dengan suara asli itu, bukan suara mesin.'))}</small>
      <div id="vpClips"></div></div>`;
    h += `<button class="bigbtn" id="vpTest">${esc(T('Coba suara'))}</button>`;
    $('vpBody').innerHTML = h;
    $('vpBody').querySelectorAll('[data-v]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { cur = b.dataset.v; onPick(cur); save(); draw(); });
    $('vpEngine').onchange = e => { S.vmap[key] = e.target.value; save(); };
    $('vpTest').onclick = () => speakPaused(SAMPLE[lang] || SAMPLE.en, lang, cur);
    if (ctx==='talk') drawClips(lang);
  };
  draw();
  if (!voiceList(lang).length && window.speechSynthesis) setTimeout(() => { if ($('vpanel').classList.contains('show')) draw(); }, 600);
  $('vpanel').classList.add('show');
}
$('vpClose').onclick = () => $('vpanel').classList.remove('show');
$('vpanel').onclick = e => { if (e.target.id==='vpanel') $('vpanel').classList.remove('show'); };

function refreshMics(){
  $('tkMic').classList.toggle('on', LT.on && TK.listening);
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-mic]').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('on', LT.on && TRS.side===b.dataset.mic));
}

/* ---------- Penyimpanan: sesi pertemuan & rekaman suara asli ---------- */
function mDb(){
  return new Promise((res, rej) => {
    if (!window.indexedDB) return rej(new Error('noidb'));
    const r = indexedDB.open('sahabattuli-meet', 1);
    r.onupgradeneeded = () => { r.result.createObjectStore('m', {keyPath:'id'}); r.result.createObjectStore('v'); };
    r.onsuccess = () => res(r.result); r.onerror = () => rej(r.error);
  });
}
async function mPut(store, val, key){ try{ const d = await mDb(); await new Promise(res => { const tx = d.transaction(store,'readwrite'); key == null ? tx.objectStore(store).put(val) : tx.objectStore(store).put(val, key); tx.oncomplete = res; tx.onerror = res; }); }catch(e){} }
async function mGet(store, key){ try{ const d = await mDb(); return await new Promise(res => { const q = d.transaction(store).objectStore(store).get(key); q.onsuccess = () => res(q.result || null); q.onerror = () => res(null); }); }catch(e){ return null; } }
async function mDel(store, key){ try{ const d = await mDb(); await new Promise(res => { const tx = d.transaction(store,'readwrite'); tx.objectStore(store).delete(key); tx.oncomplete = res; tx.onerror = res; }); }catch(e){} }
async function mAll(store){ try{ const d = await mDb(); return await new Promise(res => { const q = d.transaction(store).objectStore(store).getAll(); q.onsuccess = () => res(q.result || []); q.onerror = () => res([]); }); }catch(e){ return []; } }
const clipGet = key => mGet('v', key);

const CLIP = {mr:null, stream:null, key:null};
async function drawClips(lang){
  const el = $('vpClips'); if (!el) return;
  let h = '';
  for (let k = 0; k < QUICK.length; k++){
    const has = await clipGet(lang + '|' + k), rec = CLIP.key === lang + '|' + k;
    h += `<div class="clip"><span>${esc(T(QUICK[k]))}</span><div>
      <button class="ghost" data-crec="${k}">${rec ? '■ ' + esc(T('Berhenti')) : '● ' + esc(T('Rekam'))}</button>
      ${has ? `<button class="ghost" data-cplay="${k}">▶</button><button class="ghost" data-cdel="${k}">✕</button>` : ''}</div></div>`;
  }
  el.innerHTML = h;
  el.querySelectorAll('[data-crec]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => clipRecord(lang, +b.dataset.crec));
  el.querySelectorAll('[data-cplay]').forEach(b => b.onclick = async () => { const c = await clipGet(lang + '|' + b.dataset.cplay); if (c) playClip(c.blob); });
  el.querySelectorAll('[data-cdel]').forEach(b => b.onclick = async () => { await mDel('v', lang + '|' + b.dataset.cdel); drawClips(lang); });
}
async function clipRecord(lang, k){
  const key = lang + '|' + k;
  if (CLIP.mr){ CLIP.mr.stop(); return; }
  if (!navigator.mediaDevices || !window.MediaRecorder){ toast(T('Perangkat ini belum mendukung perekaman suara.')); return; }
  sttStop(); TK.listening = false; refreshMics();
  try{ CLIP.stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio:true}); }
  catch(e){ toast(T('Izin mikrofon ditolak. Izinkan mikrofon di pengaturan HP.')); return; }
  const chunks = [], mr = new MediaRecorder(CLIP.stream);
  CLIP.mr = mr; CLIP.key = key;
  mr.ondataavailable = e => { if (e.data && e.data.size) chunks.push(e.data); };
  mr.onstop = async () => {
    CLIP.stream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
    const blob = new Blob(chunks, {type: mr.mimeType || 'audio/webm'});
    CLIP.mr = null; CLIP.key = null;
    if (blob.size > 1500) await mPut('v', {blob}, key);
    drawClips(lang);
  };
  mr.start(); drawClips(lang);
  setTimeout(() => { if (CLIP.mr === mr) mr.stop(); }, 15000);   // paling lama 15 detik
}
function playClip(blob){
  const wasOn = LT.on, cb = LT.onText, ll = LT.lang;
  if (wasOn) sttStop();
  const a = new Audio(URL.createObjectURL(blob));
  a.onended = a.onerror = () => { URL.revokeObjectURL(a.src); if (wasOn) setTimeout(() => { sttStart(ll, cb); refreshMics(); }, 300); refreshMics(); };
  a.play().catch(() => a.onended());
  refreshMics();
}

/* ---------- Bicara <-> Tulisan ---------- */
const TK = {log:[], listening:false};
const QUICK = ['Saya Tuli. Silakan bicara ke HP ini, tulisannya akan muncul di layar.', 'Mohon bicara pelan dan jelas.', 'Bisa diulang?', 'Terima kasih.'];
function openTalk(){
  show('talk');
  $('tkTitle').textContent = T('Bicara ↔ Tulisan');
  $('tkLang').innerHTML = langOpts(S.tk.lang);
  $('tkText').placeholder = T('Ketik di sini, lalu tekan tombol suara');
  $('tkLive').dataset.ph = T('Tekan tombol mikrofon, lalu minta lawan bicara berbicara ke HP.');
  $('tkQuick').innerHTML = QUICK.map((q, k) => `<button data-q="${k}">${esc(T(q))}</button>`).join('');
  $('tkQuick').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => sayQuick(T(QUICK[+b.dataset.q]), +b.dataset.q));
  drawTalkLog(); refreshMics();
  setTimeout(() => { try{ $('tkText').focus(); }catch(e){} }, 300);   // munculkan keyboard
}
function drawTalkLog(){
  $('tkLog').innerHTML = TK.log.map((m, k) =>
    `<div class="bub ${m.who}"><small>${esc(T(m.who==='me' ? 'Saya' : 'Lawan bicara'))}</small>${esc(m.text)}${m.who==='me' ? ` <button data-r="${k}" aria-label="${esc(T('Bacakan'))}">🔊</button>` : ''}</div>`).join('');
  $('tkLog').querySelectorAll('[data-r]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { const m = TK.log[+b.dataset.r]; speakPaused(m.text, m.lang, S.tk.v); });
  $('tkLog').scrollTop = $('tkLog').scrollHeight;
}
function talkHeard(text, isFinal){
  if (isFinal){ TK.log.push({who:'them', text, lang:S.tk.lang}); $('tkLive').textContent = ''; drawTalkLog(); if (S.vib) vibrate([60]); }
  else $('tkLive').textContent = text;
}
function talkSay(text){
  text = text.trim(); if (!text) return;
  TK.log.push({who:'me', text, lang:S.tk.lang}); drawTalkLog();
  speakPaused(text, S.tk.lang, S.tk.v);
}
async function sayQuick(q, k){
  const clip = await clipGet(S.tk.lang + '|' + k);
  if (clip){                                   // ada rekaman suara manusia asli
    TK.log.push({who:'me', text:q, lang:S.tk.lang}); drawTalkLog();
    playClip(clip.blob); return;
  }
  let text = q;
  if (S.tk.lang !== LANG && SPLX[LANG]){ try{ text = await translateText(q, LANG, S.tk.lang); }catch(e){ toast(trErr(e)); return; } }
  talkSay(text);
}
$('tkSpeak').onclick = () => { talkSay($('tkText').value); $('tkText').value = ''; $('tkText').focus(); };
$('tkText').onkeydown = e => { if (e.key==='Enter' && !e.shiftKey){ e.preventDefault(); $('tkSpeak').click(); } };
$('tkMic').onclick = () => {
  if (LT.on && TK.listening){ sttStop(); TK.listening = false; $('tkLive').textContent = ''; }
  else { TK.listening = sttStart(SPLX[S.tk.lang][1], talkHeard); }
  refreshMics();
};
$('tkLang').onchange = e => { S.tk.lang = e.target.value; save(); if (LT.on && TK.listening){ sttStart(SPLX[S.tk.lang][1], talkHeard); } };
$('tkVoice').onclick = () => openVoicePanel(T('Pilihan suara'), S.tk.lang, S.tk.v, k => { S.tk.v = k; }, 'talk');
$('tkBack').onclick = () => leaveTool();
function leaveTool(){ sttStop(); stopSpeak(); TK.listening = false; TRS.side = null; refreshMics(); show('menu'); }

/* ---------- Penerjemah suara ---------- */
const TRS = {side:null, busy:false, buf:'', timer:null};
function trFinish(){
  clearTimeout(TRS.timer);
  const x = TRS.side; if (!x) return;
  sttStop(); TRS.side = null; refreshMics();
  if ($('trText'+x).value.trim()) trRun(x); else trStatus('');
}
function trStatus(t){ $('trStatus').textContent = t || ''; }
function openTr(){
  show('tr');
  $('trTitle').textContent = T('Penerjemah suara');
  $('trLangA').innerHTML = langOpts(S.trv.A.lang); $('trLangB').innerHTML = langOpts(S.trv.B.lang);
  ['A','B'].forEach(x => { $('trText'+x).placeholder = T('Ketik atau tekan mikrofon, lalu bicara'); });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-go]').forEach(b => b.textContent = b.dataset.go==='A' ? T('Terjemahkan ↓') : T('Terjemahkan ↑'));
  trStatus(T('Ketuk mikrofon di sisi yang berbicara.')); refreshMics();
}
const other = x => x==='A' ? 'B' : 'A';
async function trRun(from){
  const to = other(from), text = $('trText'+from).value.trim();
  if (!text || TRS.busy) return;
  TRS.busy = true; trStatus(T('Menerjemahkan…'));
  $('trp'+from).classList.add('act'); $('trp'+to).classList.remove('act');
  try{
    const out = await translateText(text, S.trv[from].lang, S.trv[to].lang);
    $('trText'+to).value = out; trStatus('');
    if (S.vib) vibrate([60]);
    speakPaused(out, S.trv[to].lang, S.trv[to].v);
  }catch(e){ trStatus(trErr(e)); }
  TRS.busy = false;
}
document.querySelectorAll('[data-go]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => trRun(b.dataset.go));
document.querySelectorAll('[data-say]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { const x = b.dataset.say; speakPaused($('trText'+x).value, S.trv[x].lang, S.trv[x].v); });
document.querySelectorAll('[data-voice]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { const x = b.dataset.voice; openVoicePanel(T('Pilihan suara') + ' · ' + SPLX[S.trv[x].lang][2], S.trv[x].lang, S.trv[x].v, k => { S.trv[x].v = k; }); });
document.querySelectorAll('[data-mic]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
  const x = b.dataset.mic;
  if (LT.on && TRS.side===x){ trFinish(); return; }
  if (LT.on && TRS.side){ trFinish(); }          // tekan lagi = selesai bicara
  TRS.side = x; TRS.buf = ''; $('trText'+x).value = ''; trStatus(T('Silakan bicara… Tekan mikrofon lagi bila sudah selesai.'));
  $('trp'+x).classList.add('act'); $('trp'+other(x)).classList.remove('act');
  /* kalimat dikumpulkan; berhenti sendiri bila hening 2,5 detik setelah ucapan terakhir */
  const ok = sttStart(SPLX[S.trv[x].lang][1], (text, fin) => {
    clearTimeout(TRS.timer);
    if (fin){ TRS.buf = (TRS.buf + ' ' + text).trim(); $('trText'+x).value = TRS.buf; TRS.timer = setTimeout(trFinish, 2500); }
    else $('trText'+x).value = (TRS.buf + ' ' + text).trim();
  });
  if (!ok) TRS.side = null;
  refreshMics();
});
['A','B'].forEach(x => $('trLang'+x).onchange = e => { S.trv[x].lang = e.target.value; save(); });
$('trSwap').onclick = () => {
  const a = S.trv.A; S.trv.A = S.trv.B; S.trv.B = a; save();
  const ta = $('trTextA').value; $('trTextA').value = $('trTextB').value; $('trTextB').value = ta;
  $('trLangA').innerHTML = langOpts(S.trv.A.lang); $('trLangB').innerHTML = langOpts(S.trv.B.lang);
};
$('trBack').onclick = () => leaveTool();

/* ---------- Kompas kiblat ---------- */
const KAABA = [21.422487, 39.826206];
const rad = d => d * Math.PI / 180, deg = r => r * 180 / Math.PI;
function qiblaBearing(lat, lng){
  const p1 = rad(lat), p2 = rad(KAABA[0]), dl = rad(KAABA[1] - lng);
  return (deg(Math.atan2(Math.sin(dl), Math.cos(p1) * Math.tan(p2) - Math.sin(p1) * Math.cos(dl))) + 360) % 360;
}
function distKm(lat, lng){
  const p1 = rad(lat), p2 = rad(KAABA[0]), dp = p2 - p1, dl = rad(KAABA[1] - lng);
  const a = Math.sin(dp/2)**2 + Math.cos(p1) * Math.cos(p2) * Math.sin(dl/2)**2;
  return 6371 * 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
}
/* kota cadangan bila lokasi GPS tidak tersedia */
const CITIES = [['Banyuwangi',-8.2192,114.3691],['Surabaya',-7.2575,112.7521],['Malang',-7.9666,112.6326],['Jember',-8.1724,113.7003],['Jakarta',-6.2088,106.8456],
  ['Bandung',-6.9175,107.6191],['Semarang',-6.9667,110.4167],['Yogyakarta',-7.7956,110.3695],['Denpasar',-8.6705,115.2126],['Makassar',-5.1477,119.4327],
  ['Medan',3.5952,98.6722],['Banda Aceh',5.5483,95.3238],['Pontianak',-0.0263,109.3425],['Jayapura',-2.5337,140.7181],['Kuala Lumpur',3.139,101.6869],
  ['Singapore',1.3521,103.8198],['Bandar Seri Begawan',4.9031,114.9398],['Istanbul',41.0082,28.9784],['Cairo',30.0444,31.2357],['Karachi',24.8607,67.0011],
  ['London',51.5072,-0.1276],['Paris',48.8566,2.3522],['New York',40.7128,-74.006],['Sydney',-33.8688,151.2093],['Tokyo',35.6762,139.6503]];
const QB = {on:false, loc:null, head:null, bearing:null, ok:false, web:null, src:'', smooth:null};
function openQibla(){
  show('qibla'); QB.on = true; QB.head = null; QB.ok = false;
  $('qbTitle').textContent = T('Kompas kiblat');
  $('qbTip').textContent = T('Letakkan HP mendatar di telapak tangan, jauhkan dari benda logam dan magnet. Bila arah terasa melenceng, gerakkan HP membentuk angka 8 beberapa kali untuk kalibrasi.');
  drawRose(); drawLocUI();
  if (S.qloc) setQLoc(S.qloc.lat, S.qloc.lng, S.qloc.name, true);
  findLocation();
  startHeading();
  qbUpdate();
}
function drawRose(){
  const b = QB.bearing;
  let g = '<circle cx="150" cy="150" r="140" fill="url(#qbg)" stroke="#E9B949" stroke-width="3"/>';
  for (let a = 0; a < 360; a += 5){
    const big = a % 30 === 0, r1 = big ? 118 : 126, x1 = 150 + r1 * Math.sin(rad(a)), y1 = 150 - r1 * Math.cos(rad(a));
    const x2 = 150 + 134 * Math.sin(rad(a)), y2 = 150 - 134 * Math.cos(rad(a));
    g += `<line x1="${x1.toFixed(1)}" y1="${y1.toFixed(1)}" x2="${x2.toFixed(1)}" y2="${y2.toFixed(1)}" stroke="#a9b9c6" stroke-width="${big ? 2.5 : 1}"/>`;
  }
  [['U',0,'#ff6b6b'],['T',90,'#F3EBD8'],['S',180,'#F3EBD8'],['B',270,'#F3EBD8']].forEach(([l, a, c]) => {
    const x = 150 + 100 * Math.sin(rad(a)), y = 150 - 100 * Math.cos(rad(a)) + 9;
    g += `<text x="${x.toFixed(1)}" y="${y.toFixed(1)}" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="800" fill="${c}">${T(l)}</text>`;
  });
  if (b != null){
    const x = 150 + 92 * Math.sin(rad(b)), y = 150 - 92 * Math.cos(rad(b));
    g += `<line x1="150" y1="150" x2="${x.toFixed(1)}" y2="${y.toFixed(1)}" stroke="#3FA37C" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>`;
    g += `<g transform="translate(${x.toFixed(1)} ${y.toFixed(1)}) rotate(${b.toFixed(1)})"><rect x="-17" y="-17" width="34" height="34" rx="3" fill="#111" stroke="#E9B949" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="-17" y="-8" width="34" height="5" fill="#E9B949"/></g>`;
  }
  g += '<circle cx="150" cy="150" r="9" fill="#E9B949"/>';
  $('qbRose').innerHTML = g;
}
function drawLocUI(msg){
  $('qbLoc').innerHTML = (msg ? `<p class="dznote">${esc(msg)}</p>` : '') +
    `<button class="ghost" id="qbGps">📍 ${esc(T('Pakai lokasi saya sekarang'))}</button>
     <select id="qbCity"><option value="">${esc(T('Atau pilih kota terdekat…'))}</option>${CITIES.map((c, k) => `<option value="${k}">${esc(c[0])}</option>`).join('')}</select>`;
  $('qbGps').onclick = () => findLocation(true);
  $('qbCity').onchange = e => { const c = CITIES[+e.target.value]; if (c) setQLoc(c[1], c[2], c[0]); };
}
function setQLoc(lat, lng, name, quiet){
  QB.loc = {lat, lng, name}; S.qloc = QB.loc; save();
  QB.bearing = qiblaBearing(lat, lng);
  if (window.Android && Android.startCompass && QB.src==='native') Android.startCompass(lat, lng);   // koreksi deklinasi magnet
  drawRose(); qbUpdate();
  if (!quiet) toast(T('Lokasi: {n}', {n: name || (lat.toFixed(3) + ', ' + lng.toFixed(3))}));
}
function findLocation(user){
  if (!navigator.geolocation){ drawLocUI(T('Lokasi tidak tersedia. Pilih kota terdekat.')); return; }
  $('qbMsg').textContent = T('Mencari lokasi…');
  navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
    p => { setQLoc(p.coords.latitude, p.coords.longitude, T('lokasi saya'), !user); drawLocUI(); },
    () => { drawLocUI(T('Lokasi belum didapat. Nyalakan GPS dan izinkan lokasi, atau pilih kota terdekat.')); qbUpdate(); },
    {enableHighAccuracy:true, timeout:15000, maximumAge:600000});
}
/* arah HP terhadap utara (derajat) */
window.onHeading = (h, acc) => { QB.src = 'native'; setHeading(h); if (acc != null && acc < 2) $('qbTip').classList.add('warn'); };
function setHeading(h){
  if (QB.smooth == null) QB.smooth = h;
  let d = ((h - QB.smooth + 540) % 360) - 180;       // perhalus agar jarum tidak bergetar
  QB.smooth = (QB.smooth + d * 0.25 + 360) % 360;
  QB.head = QB.smooth; qbUpdate();
}
function startHeading(){
  QB.smooth = null;
  if (window.Android && Android.startCompass){
    QB.src = 'native';
    try{ Android.startCompass(QB.loc ? QB.loc.lat : 0, QB.loc ? QB.loc.lng : 0); }catch(e){}
    return;
  }
  QB.src = 'web';
  const hdl = e => {
    let h = null;
    if (e.webkitCompassHeading != null) h = e.webkitCompassHeading;
    else if (e.absolute && e.alpha != null) h = (360 - e.alpha) % 360;
    if (h != null) setHeading(h);
  };
  QB.web = hdl;
  window.addEventListener('deviceorientationabsolute', hdl);
  window.addEventListener('deviceorientation', hdl);
  if (window.DeviceOrientationEvent && DeviceOrientationEvent.requestPermission) DeviceOrientationEvent.requestPermission().catch(() => {});
}
function stopHeading(){
  if (window.Android && Android.stopCompass){ try{ Android.stopCompass(); }catch(e){} }
  if (QB.web){ window.removeEventListener('deviceorientationabsolute', QB.web); window.removeEventListener('deviceorientation', QB.web); QB.web = null; }
}
function qbUpdate(){
  if (!$('qibla').classList.contains('active')) return;
  const b = QB.bearing, h = QB.head;
  $('qbSvg').querySelector('#qbRose').setAttribute('transform', h == null ? '' : `rotate(${(-h).toFixed(1)} 150 150)`);
  let msg = '', ok = false;
  if (b == null) msg = T('Tentukan lokasi Anda terlebih dahulu.');
  else if (h == null) msg = T('Sensor kompas tidak terbaca. Arah kiblat: {d}° dari utara.', {d: Math.round(b)});
  else {
    const d = ((b - h + 540) % 360) - 180;
    if (Math.abs(d) <= (S.qbTol || 3)){ ok = true; msg = T('✓ Anda sudah menghadap kiblat'); }
    else msg = d > 0 ? T('Putar ke kanan {d}°', {d: Math.round(d)}) : T('Putar ke kiri {d}°', {d: Math.round(-d)});
  }
  if (ok && !QB.ok && S.qbVib !== false) vibrate([500]);          // getar saat tepat menghadap kiblat
  QB.ok = ok;
  $('qbMsg').textContent = msg; $('qbMsg').classList.toggle('ok', ok); $('qbDial').classList.toggle('ok', ok);
  $('qbInfo').innerHTML = b == null ? '' :
    `<div><b>${Math.round(b)}°</b><small>${esc(T('Arah kiblat dari utara'))}</small></div>
     <div><b>${Math.round(distKm(QB.loc.lat, QB.loc.lng)).toLocaleString()} km</b><small>${esc(T("Jarak ke Ka'bah"))}</small></div>`;
}
/* Pengaturan kompas kiblat: petunjuk pemakaian, batas ketepatan, getar */
const QB_TIPS = ['Pegang HP mendatar, jauh dari benda logam, magnet, atau speaker.',
  'Jika arah terasa melenceng, gerakkan HP membentuk angka 8 beberapa kali untuk kalibrasi.',
  'Sebaiknya bandingkan sekali dengan arah kiblat masjid terdekat.'];
function openQbSettings(){
  $('vpTitle').textContent = T('Pengaturan') + ' · ' + T('Kompas kiblat');
  const draw = () => {
    const tol = S.qbTol || 3;
    $('vpBody').innerHTML =
      `<div class="set"><label class="t">${esc(T('Petunjuk pemakaian'))}</label>
        <ol class="qbtips">${QB_TIPS.map(t => `<li>${esc(T(t))}</li>`).join('')}</ol></div>
       <div class="set"><label class="t">${esc(T('Batas ketepatan'))}</label>
        <div class="chips" id="qbTol">${[2,3,5].map(v => `<button data-v="${v}" aria-pressed="${v===tol}">±${v}°</button>`).join('')}</div>
        <small>${esc(T('Seberapa dekat arah HP dengan kiblat agar dianggap sudah menghadap kiblat.'))}</small></div>
       <div class="set"><div class="sw"><span>${esc(T('Getar saat menghadap kiblat'))}</span><input type="checkbox" id="qbVib"${S.qbVib !== false ? ' checked' : ''}></div></div>`;
    $('qbTol').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { S.qbTol = +b.dataset.v; save(); draw(); qbUpdate(); });
    $('qbVib').onchange = e => { S.qbVib = e.target.checked; save(); };
  };
  draw();
  $('vpanel').classList.add('show');
}
$('qbSet').onclick = openQbSettings;

function closeQibla(){ QB.on = false; stopHeading(); show('menu'); }
$('qbBack').onclick = closeQibla;

/* ---------- Teks pertemuan (layar penuh, otomatis tersimpan) ---------- */
if (!S.mt) S.mt = {lang: SPLX[LANG] ? LANG : 'id', size:34, col:'wk', font:'jelas'};
const MTF = {   // huruf yang mudah dan cepat dibaca
  jelas:'Verdana, Tahoma, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif',
  lebar:'"Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Lexend", Roboto, "Segoe UI", sans-serif',
  tegas:'"Arial Black", "Roboto Black", Roboto, sans-serif'
};
const MT = {on:false, paused:false, sess:null, view:false, saveT:null, hideT:null};
function openMeet(){ show('meet'); MT.view = false; drawMeetHome(); }
function meetStyle(){
  const el = $('mtScroll');
  el.style.fontSize = S.mt.size + 'px';
  el.style.fontFamily = MTF[S.mt.font] || MTF.jelas;
  $('mtFull').dataset.col = S.mt.col;
}
async function drawMeetHome(){
  $('mtFull').hidden = true;
  const list = (await mAll('m')).sort((a, b) => b.id - a.id);
  const col = {wk:T('Putih di hitam'), yk:T('Kuning di hitam'), kw:T('Hitam di putih')};
  const fnt = {jelas:T('Jelas'), lebar:T('Lebar'), tegas:T('Tegas')};
  let h = `<p class="dznote">${esc(T('Letakkan HP di tengah meja. Semua ucapan yang tertangkap mikrofon akan tampil sebagai tulisan besar di layar penuh dan tersimpan otomatis.'))}</p>
    <div class="set"><label class="t">${esc(T('Bahasa yang diucapkan'))}</label><select class="lsel" id="mtLang" style="max-width:none;width:100%">${langOpts(S.mt.lang)}</select></div>
    <div class="set"><label class="t">${esc(T('Ukuran tulisan'))}</label><div class="range"><button class="sq" id="mtMinus">A−</button><input type="range" id="mtSize" min="18" max="96" step="2" value="${S.mt.size}"><button class="sq" id="mtPlus">A+</button></div>
      <div class="mtprev" id="mtPrev" data-col="${S.mt.col}"><span style="font-size:${S.mt.size}px;font-family:${esc(MTF[S.mt.font])}">${esc(T('Contoh tulisan'))}</span></div></div>
    <div class="set"><label class="t">${esc(T('Warna'))}</label><div class="chips" id="mtCol">${Object.keys(col).map(k => `<button data-k="${k}" aria-pressed="${k===S.mt.col}">${esc(col[k])}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>
    <div class="set"><label class="t">${esc(T('Jenis huruf'))}</label><div class="chips" id="mtFont">${Object.keys(fnt).map(k => `<button data-k="${k}" aria-pressed="${k===S.mt.font}" style="font-family:${esc(MTF[k])}">${esc(fnt[k])}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>
    <button class="bigbtn" id="mtStart">${esc(T('Mulai menangkap ucapan'))}</button>
    <h2 class="dzh">${esc(T('Sesi tersimpan'))}</h2>`;
  if (!list.length) h += `<p class="empty">${esc(T('Belum ada sesi.'))}</p>`;
  list.forEach(m => {
    const d = new Date(m.id), words = m.lines.map(l => l.x).join(' ');
    let when; try{ when = d.toLocaleString(undefined, {day:'numeric', month:'short', year:'numeric', hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'}); }catch(e){ when = d.toString(); }
    h += `<button class="mtitem" data-id="${m.id}"><b>${esc(when)} · ${esc(SPLX[m.lang] ? SPLX[m.lang][2] : m.lang)}</b><span>${esc(words.slice(0, 110) || '…')}</span></button>`;
  });
  $('mtHome').innerHTML = h;
  const sz = v => { S.mt.size = Math.max(18, Math.min(96, v)); save(); $('mtSize').value = S.mt.size; $('mtPrev').firstChild.style.fontSize = S.mt.size + 'px'; };
  $('mtSize').oninput = e => sz(+e.target.value);
  $('mtMinus').onclick = () => sz(S.mt.size - 4); $('mtPlus').onclick = () => sz(S.mt.size + 4);
  $('mtLang').onchange = e => { S.mt.lang = e.target.value; save(); };
  $('mtCol').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { S.mt.col = b.dataset.k; save(); drawMeetHome(); });
  $('mtFont').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { S.mt.font = b.dataset.k; save(); drawMeetHome(); });
  $('mtStart').onclick = startMeet;
  $('mtHome').querySelectorAll('.mtitem').forEach(b => b.onclick = async () => { const m = await mGet('m', +b.dataset.id); if (m) viewMeet(m); });
}
function setFull(on){
  try{
    if (window.Android && Android.setImmersive) Android.setImmersive(on);
    else if (on && document.documentElement.requestFullscreen) document.documentElement.requestFullscreen().catch(() => {});
    else if (!on && document.fullscreenElement) document.exitFullscreen().catch(() => {});
  }catch(e){}
}
function enterFull(){ $('mtFull').hidden = false; meetStyle(); setFull(true); keepAwake(); showCtl(); }
function mtLine(l){
  const p = document.createElement('p');
  let t = ''; try{ t = new Date(l.t).toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'}); }catch(e){}
  p.innerHTML = `<small>${esc(t)}</small>${esc(l.x)}`;
  return p;
}
function atBottom(){ const el = $('mtScroll'); return el.scrollHeight - el.scrollTop - el.clientHeight < 80; }
function toBottom(){ const el = $('mtScroll'); el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight; $('mtNew').hidden = true; }
function startMeet(){
  MT.sess = {id: Date.now(), lang: S.mt.lang, lines: []};
  MT.view = false; MT.paused = false;
  $('mtLines').innerHTML = ''; $('mtPart').textContent = '';
  enterFull(); drawCtl();
  meetListen();
}
function meetListen(){
  const ok = sttStart(SPLX[MT.sess.lang][1], meetHeard);
  MT.on = !!ok; drawCtl();
  $('mtPart').textContent = ok ? '' : T('Pengenalan ucapan tidak tersedia di perangkat ini.');
}
function meetHeard(text, fin){
  const stick = atBottom();
  if (fin){
    const l = {t: Date.now(), x: text};
    MT.sess.lines.push(l); $('mtLines').appendChild(mtLine(l)); $('mtPart').textContent = '';
    clearTimeout(MT.saveT); MT.saveT = setTimeout(() => mPut('m', MT.sess), 400);   // tersimpan otomatis
  } else $('mtPart').textContent = text;
  if (stick) toBottom(); else $('mtNew').hidden = false;
}
function viewMeet(m){
  MT.sess = m; MT.view = true; MT.on = false;
  $('mtLines').innerHTML = ''; m.lines.forEach(l => $('mtLines').appendChild(mtLine(l))); $('mtPart').textContent = '';
  enterFull(); drawCtl(); setTimeout(toBottom, 50);
}
function meetText(){ return MT.sess.lines.map(l => { let t = ''; try{ t = new Date(l.t).toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'}); }catch(e){} return '[' + t + '] ' + l.x; }).join('\n'); }
function drawCtl(){
  const b = [];
  b.push(['minus','A−'], ['plus','A+']);
  if (!MT.view) b.push(['pause', MT.on ? '⏸ ' + T('Jeda') : '▶ ' + T('Lanjut')]);
  b.push(['copy', T('Salin')], ['share', T('Bagikan')]);
  if (MT.view) b.push(['del', T('Hapus')]);
  b.push(['close', '✕ ' + T('Selesai')]);
  $('mtCtl').innerHTML = b.map(([k, l]) => `<button data-c="${k}">${esc(l)}</button>`).join('');
  $('mtCtl').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(x => x.onclick = ev => { ev.stopPropagation(); mtCmd(x.dataset.c); showCtl(); });
}
function showCtl(){ $('mtCtl').classList.add('show'); clearTimeout(MT.hideT); MT.hideT = setTimeout(() => $('mtCtl').classList.remove('show'), 3500); }
async function mtCmd(c){
  if (c==='minus' || c==='plus'){ S.mt.size = Math.max(18, Math.min(96, S.mt.size + (c==='plus' ? 4 : -4))); save(); const s2 = atBottom(); meetStyle(); if (s2) toBottom(); }
  else if (c==='pause'){ if (MT.on){ sttStop(); MT.on = false; $('mtPart').textContent = ''; } else meetListen(); drawCtl(); }
  else if (c==='copy'){ try{ await navigator.clipboard.writeText(meetText()); toast(T('Tulisan disalin.')); }catch(e){ toast(T('Gagal menyalin.')); } }
  else if (c==='share'){
    const t = meetText();
    if (window.Android && Android.shareText) Android.shareText(t);
    else if (navigator.share) navigator.share({text: t}).catch(() => {});
    else { try{ await navigator.clipboard.writeText(t); toast(T('Tulisan disalin.')); }catch(e){} }
  }
  else if (c==='del'){ askYesNo(T('Hapus sesi ini?'), async () => { await mDel('m', MT.sess.id); closeMeet(); }); }
  else if (c==='close') closeMeet();
}
function closeMeet(){
  if (MT.on) sttStop();
  if (!MT.view && MT.sess && MT.sess.lines.length) mPut('m', MT.sess);
  MT.on = false; clearTimeout(MT.hideT); setFull(false);
  $('mtFull').hidden = true; drawMeetHome();
}
$('mtFull').onclick = () => showCtl();
$('mtNew').onclick = ev => { ev.stopPropagation(); toBottom(); };
$('mtScroll').onscroll = () => { if (atBottom()) $('mtNew').hidden = true; };
/* cubit dua jari untuk memperbesar / memperkecil tulisan */
(function(){
  let d0 = 0, s0 = 0;
  const dist = e => Math.hypot(e.touches[0].clientX - e.touches[1].clientX, e.touches[0].clientY - e.touches[1].clientY);
  $('mtScroll').addEventListener('touchstart', e => { if (e.touches.length === 2){ d0 = dist(e); s0 = S.mt.size; } }, {passive:true});
  $('mtScroll').addEventListener('touchmove', e => { if (e.touches.length === 2 && d0){ S.mt.size = Math.round(Math.max(18, Math.min(96, s0 * dist(e) / d0))); meetStyle(); } }, {passive:true});
  $('mtScroll').addEventListener('touchend', () => { if (d0){ d0 = 0; save(); } }, {passive:true});
})();
$('mtBack').onclick = () => { if (!$('mtFull').hidden) closeMeet(); show('menu'); };

/* ---------- Pilihan madzhab ---------- */
const MZ_AREA = {
  syafii:'Asia Tenggara, Mesir, Yaman, Afrika Timur, Kurdistan',
  hanafi:'Turki, Asia Selatan, Asia Tengah, Balkan, Levant',
  maliki:'Afrika Utara dan Barat, Sudan, sebagian Teluk',
  hanbali:'Arab Saudi, Qatar, sebagian Teluk'
};
function mzNames(){ const o = {}; for (const k in MZ) o[k] = T(MZ[k].n); return o; }
function renderMz(){
  $('mzNow').textContent = T('Madzhab: {m}', {m: T(mz().n)});
  $('mzList').innerHTML = Object.keys(MZ).map(k => `<button data-k="${k}" aria-pressed="${k===S.madhab}"><strong>${esc(T(MZ[k].n))}</strong><span>${esc(T(MZ_AREA[k]))}</span></button>`).join('');
  $('mzList').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => setMadhab(b.dataset.k));
  const l2 = $('langSel2');
  l2.innerHTML = Object.keys(LANGS).map(k => `<option value="${k}"${k===LANG?' selected':''}>${LANGS[k]}</option>`).join('');
}
function openMzPick(){ renderMz(); $('mzPick').hidden = false; }
function setMadhab(k){
  if (!MZ[k]) return;
  S.madhab = k; save(); $('mzPick').hidden = true;
  if ($('menu').classList.contains('active')) show('home');
  renderMz(); fillSettings();
  if ($('guide').classList.contains('active')) renderGuide();
  if ($('dz').classList.contains('active')) renderDz();
  if (st.key && $('pray').classList.contains('active')){ const i = st.i; st.steps = buildSteps(st.key); st.i = Math.min(i, st.steps.length-1); render(false); }
}
$('btnMz').onclick = openMzPick;
$('langSel2').onchange = e => setLang(e.target.value);

/* ---------- Menerapkan bahasa ke seluruh tampilan ---------- */
const I18N_SKIP = '#qibla, #menuTiles, #meet, #talk, #tr, #vpanel, #lblMenu, #splash, #dzTitle, #dzTabs, #dzList, #gTitle, #mzNow, #mzList, .mzlang, #pgrid, #glist, #rlist, #tabs, #mkFit, #imFit, .c-app, .c-made, #appVer, #move, #sub, #next, #status, #tbTitle, #imLabel, #imExtra, #mkLabel, #coverTitle, #dlgText, .chips, .preview, #qStatus, .hero h1, #toast, .langsel';
function i18nStatic(){
  document.querySelectorAll('h2, p, button, label.t, .sw > span, small').forEach(el => {
    if (el.closest(I18N_SKIP)) return;
    if (el.tagName === 'SMALL' && el.closest('.sw > span')) return;
    if (el.dataset.src == null){
      const h = el.innerHTML.trim();
      if (!h || h.startsWith('<svg') || !/[a-z]/i.test(h)) return;
      el.dataset.src = h;
    }
    el.innerHTML = T(el.dataset.src);
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('[aria-label], [title]').forEach(el => {
    if (el.closest('#mkFit, #imFit, #rlist, #glist, #figWrap')) return;
    [['aria-label','srcA'], ['title','srcT']].forEach(([a, k]) => {
      if (!el.hasAttribute(a)) return;
      if (el.dataset[k] == null) el.dataset[k] = el.getAttribute(a);
      el.setAttribute(a, T(el.dataset[k]));
    });
  });
}
function showVersion(){
  let v = APP_VERSION;
  try{ if (window.Android && Android.appVersion){ const nv = Android.appVersion(); if (nv) v = nv; } }catch(e){}
  $('appVer').textContent = T('Versi {v}', {v});
}
function applyLang(){
  document.documentElement.lang = LANG;
  document.documentElement.dir = RTL[LANG] ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';
  i18nStatic();
  $('btnPrev').textContent = RTL[LANG] ? '▶' : '◀';
  $('btnNext').textContent = RTL[LANG] ? '◀' : '▶';
  renderHome(); fillSettings(); qStatus(); showVersion(); updRecBtn(); renderMz();
  document.querySelectorAll('.langsel select').forEach(x => x.value = LANG);
  renderMenu();
  $('mtTitle').textContent = T('Teks pertemuan');
  if ($('meet').classList.contains('active')) drawMeetHome();
  if ($('qibla').classList.contains('active')){ $('qbTitle').textContent = T('Kompas kiblat'); drawRose(); drawLocUI(); qbUpdate(); }
  if ($('talk').classList.contains('active')) openTalk();
  if ($('tr').classList.contains('active')) openTr();
  if ($('guide').classList.contains('active')) renderGuide();
  if ($('recs').classList.contains('active')) renderRecs();
  if ($('dz').classList.contains('active')) renderDz();
  if (st.key && $('pray').classList.contains('active')){
    const i = st.i; st.steps = buildSteps(st.key); st.i = Math.min(i, st.steps.length-1); render(false);
    if ($('cover').classList.contains('show')) $('coverTitle').textContent = T('Shalat {p}', {p: T(PRAYERS[st.key].n)});
  }
  loadTrans(LANG);
}
function setLang(k){ if (!LANGS[k]) return; S.lang = k; LANG = k; save(); applyLang(); }

/* ---------- Versi aplikasi ---------- */
const APP_VERSION = '2.2.1';

/* ---------- Mulai ---------- */
applySettings(); applyLang();
runSplash(() => show('menu'));
loadQuran();
</script>
</body>
</html>
